vectors.name: conformance-10-reply-alternatives
vectors.input:
---
name: fmt-reply-alternatives
description: Formatter vector fmt-reply-alternatives.
engine: 0.2.0-lab.1
roles: [lead, deployer]
---
contract @1h => expired
role lead
role deployer
type deploy
type ok
  request: ref(deploy)
type error
  request: ref(deploy)
  retryable: boolean
type progress
type abandon
state new
  lead -> deployer: deploy() awaits deploying
  "A success."
        =>ok()&deployed
  %% Two errors, by retryable.
  |error(retryable=true)   &   retrying
"""
Not retryable.
"""
  | error(retryable=false) &failed
     |   @10m&stalled
state deploying max_entries 3 => exhausted
  event deployer -> lead: progress() => @self
state retrying
  "Resend; a reply to the earlier deploy can no longer match."
  lead -> deployer: deploy() =>deploying
  lead -> deployer: abandon() => failed
end deployed
end failed
end stalled
end exhausted
vectors.expected:
